meta.description: The master template: the questions a measurement standard answers, with neutral 'as modelled' answers as defaults. Build your own standard by extending it and changing only the answers that differ.

sections.title: General
sections.intro: How lines are organised for every item.

sections.title: Earthworks and substructure
sections.intro: Excavation, blinding and hardcore are rarely modelled; these answers derive them from footings and ground slabs.

sections.title: Concrete, formwork and reinforcement
sections.intro: Formwork and reinforcement are rarely modelled; these answers decide how they are derived.

sections.title: Openings and deductions
sections.intro: What is deducted for windows, doors and voids, and how the openings themselves are measured.

sections.title: Finishes
sections.intro: Ceilings, floor and wall finishes, painting and skirting.

lines_by_storey.label: Lines per storey
lines_by_storey.question: Do you want separate BoQ lines for each storey?
lines_by_storey.help: Without it, items of the same kind are summed over the whole building. Each line keeps its storey either way.

excavation.label: Excavation for footings
excavation.question: Do you measure excavation for foundations?
excavation.help: Earthworks are almost never modelled; this derives them from the footings.

working_space.label: Working space
working_space.question: How much working space is added on each side of a footing?

excavation_formula.label: Formula: excavation

choices.label: Footing plan plus the working space on every side, times the footing height
As above, down to the underside of the blinding (when blinding is measured)
The footing's own volume, no working space

excavation_formula.question: How do you calculate excavation for a footing?
excavation_formula.variables: The footing: length, width, height, net volume; the working space and blinding answers
excavation_formula.help: Default: footing plan enlarged by the working space on every side, times the footing depth.

blinding.label: Blinding under footings
blinding.question: Do you measure blinding concrete under footings?

blinding_thickness.label: Blinding thickness
blinding_thickness.question: How thick is the blinding layer?

hardcore.label: Hardcore under ground slabs
hardcore.question: Do you measure a hardcore (gravel) bed under ground-floor slabs?

hardcore_thickness.label: Hardcore thickness
hardcore_thickness.question: How thick is the hardcore bed?

formwork_separate.label: Formwork as separate item
formwork_separate.question: Is formwork measured as its own item?
formwork_separate.help: Some standards include formwork in the concrete item; then there are no formwork lines.

formwork_factor.label: Formwork allowance factor
formwork_factor.question: Do you add an allowance to formwork areas? (1 = none, 1.05 = 5 %)

choices.label: One face only, openings not deducted

formwork_walls_formula.label: Formula: wall formwork
formwork_walls_formula.question: How do you calculate formwork to concrete walls?
formwork_walls_formula.variables: The concrete wall: its two faces (side a, side b) with gross and net area, length, height, thickness, openings
formwork_walls_formula.help: Default: both faces of the wall, openings not deducted (gross).

choices.label: Outer edge and the edges of openings

formwork_slab_edges_formula.label: Formula: slab edge formwork
formwork_slab_edges_formula.question: How do you calculate edge formwork to concrete slabs?
formwork_slab_edges_formula.variables: The concrete slab: perimeter, thickness, net area, openings (each with width, height, perimeter)

formwork_footings_formula.label: Formula: footing formwork
formwork_footings_formula.question: How do you calculate formwork to the sides of footings?
formwork_footings_formula.variables: The footing: length, width, height, perimeter

rebar_estimates.label: Reinforcement estimates
rebar_estimates.question: When the model has no reinforcement, do you estimate it from concrete volumes?

rebar_slab_kg_m3.label: Reinforcement in slabs
rebar_slab_kg_m3.question: How many kg of reinforcement per m3 of slab concrete?

rebar_wall_kg_m3.label: Reinforcement in walls
rebar_wall_kg_m3.question: How many kg of reinforcement per m3 of wall concrete?

rebar_footing_kg_m3.label: Reinforcement in footings
rebar_footing_kg_m3.question: How many kg of reinforcement per m3 of footing concrete?

optionLabels.volume_from_thickness: m3 from a thickness, m2 below it

wall_unit.label: Wall unit
wall_unit.question: In what unit are walls measured?
wall_unit.help: Many standards measure thin walls and linings by area, and thick masonry or concrete walls by volume.

masonry_volume_from.label: m3 from wall thickness
masonry_volume_from.question: From which thickness are walls measured in m3?
masonry_volume_from.help: Walls at least this thick are measured by volume, thinner ones by area.

wall_surface.label: Wall face measured
wall_surface.question: Which face of a wall is measured?
wall_surface.help: The engine does not measure each face separately yet, so all choices except 'both sides' currently give the same area.

wall_opening_mode.label: Wall opening deduction
wall_opening_mode.question: Which openings (windows, doors, voids) are deducted from walls?

optionLabels.over_threshold: Deduct openings larger than a size, in full
optionLabels.excess_only: Deduct only the part of each opening above a size
optionLabels.per_element_sum: Deduct all openings if together they exceed a size

wall_opening_mode.example: A 3 x 10 m wall with one 0.6 m2 window: deduct every opening gives 29.4 m2; deduct only openings over 1 m2 gives 30 m2.

wall_opening_threshold.label: Wall opening size limit
wall_opening_threshold.question: What is the size limit for deducting openings from walls?
wall_opening_threshold.help: In m2 when compared by area, in m when compared by width.

opening_compare_by.label: Opening size measured by
opening_compare_by.question: Is that size limit about an opening's area or its width?

wall_add_reveals.label: Add reveals back
wall_add_reveals.question: When an opening is deducted, are its reveals (the sides of the opening) added back?

slab_opening_mode.label: Slab opening deduction
slab_opening_mode.question: Which openings are deducted from floor and roof slabs?

optionLabels.over_threshold: Deduct openings larger than a size, in full
optionLabels.excess_only: Deduct only the part of each opening above a size
optionLabels.per_element_sum: Deduct all openings if together they exceed a size

slab_opening_threshold.label: Slab opening size limit
slab_opening_threshold.question: What is the size limit for deducting openings from slabs?

deduct_embedded.label: Deduct elements passing through
deduct_embedded.question: Are columns and beams passing through slabs deducted?
deduct_embedded.help: Columns, beams and members whose solids pass through a slab: the area they take out of it (shared volume / slab thickness). Found from the geometry, also across models of a federation; elements the modeller already cut out deduct nothing.

embedded_threshold.label: Size limit for elements passing through
embedded_threshold.question: Above which plan area are elements passing through slabs deducted?

optionLabels.over_threshold: Recesses larger than a size limit deducted

wall_recess_mode.label: Wall recess deduction
wall_recess_mode.question: Are recesses (niches, chases that do not go through the wall) deducted from walls measured in m3?
wall_recess_mode.help: Only walls measured by volume lose recesses; wall areas never do. A recess is an opening the model marks as one (IFC RECESS).

wall_recess_threshold.label: Recess size limit
wall_recess_threshold.question: Above which face area are recesses deducted?

slab_surface.label: Slab area basis
slab_surface.question: Which surface of a floor slab is measured?

slab_concrete_separate.label: Slab concrete as own item
slab_concrete_separate.question: Is the concrete in floor slabs measured as its own item (m3), besides the slab area (m2)?
slab_concrete_separate.help: Reinforcement estimates for slabs are taken from this item.

roof_surface.label: Roof area basis
roof_surface.question: Is roof area measured along the slope or in plan?

optionLabels.layer: One line per roof layer (membrane, insulation, deck…)

roof_breakdown.label: Roof lines
roof_breakdown.question: Is a roof one item, or is each layer of its build-up measured separately?

railing_measure.label: Railings measured by
railing_measure.question: How are railings and balustrades measured?

railing_basis.label: Railing length
railing_basis.question: Which length of a railing is measured?

paint_walls.label: Paint to walls
paint_walls.question: Do you measure painting to plasterboard wall surfaces?

paint_walls_formula.label: Formula: wall paint

choices.label: Area of every plasterboard layer of the wall
Wall faces that bound a room, openings deducted (needs rooms in the model)

paint_walls_formula.question: How do you calculate the painted wall area?
paint_walls_formula.variables: The wall: its layers (material, area, thickness), its faces (with the room on each), openings, net area
paint_walls_formula.help: Default: the area of every plasterboard layer of the wall.

paint_ceilings.label: Paint to ceilings
paint_ceilings.question: Do you measure painting to ceilings as its own item?

skirting.label: Skirting
skirting.question: Do you measure skirting along floor finishes?
skirting.help: Taken from modelled floor coverings. Models that put floor finishes in slab layers give no skirting.

skirting_formula.label: Formula: skirting
skirting_formula.question: How do you calculate skirting length?
skirting_formula.variables: The floor covering: perimeter, openings (doors with their width), net area
skirting_formula.help: Default: the perimeter of the floor finish less door openings.

finishes_by_type.label: Finishes by type
finishes_by_type.question: Are finishes (ceilings, floor and wall coverings) split by their type name?
finishes_by_type.help: No: one line per kind of finish (ceiling, flooring…) whatever its type.

steel_mass_basis.label: Steel mass basis
steel_mass_basis.question: How is the weight of steel sections found?

optionLabels.nominal_per_length: Length x nominal kg/m of the section

steel_density.label: Steel density
steel_density.question: What steel density do you use?

linear_basis.label: Length basis for beams/columns
linear_basis.question: Which length is measured for beams, columns and other members?

members_measure.label: Other members measured by
members_measure.question: How are beams, columns and members that are not steel (timber, concrete) measured?

include_mep.label: Include services
include_mep.question: Are building services (pipes, ducts, cables, fixtures) part of this BoQ?
include_mep.help: Often they are priced in a separate MEP bill, or measured from the MEP model.

pipe_basis.label: Pipe length basis
pipe_basis.question: Which length of pipes, ducts and cables is measured?

pipe_allowance.label: Allowance for fittings
pipe_allowance.question: Do you add an allowance for fittings to pipe and duct lengths? (1 = none, 1.1 = 10 %)

include_prelims.label: Include preliminaries
include_prelims.question: Does the BoQ include preliminaries (site setup, scaffolding)?
include_prelims.help: These lines have no model behind them; the quantity is entered by the user.

include_provisional.label: Include provisional sums
include_provisional.question: Does the BoQ include provisional sums (e.g. landscaping)?

include_furniture.label: Include loose furniture
include_furniture.question: Is loose furniture included in the BoQ?

include_proxies.label: Count unknown objects
include_proxies.question: Are unclassified model objects (proxies) counted as items?
include_proxies.help: No: they are left out and listed as excluded. Either way they are reported.

include_non_physical.label: Count marker objects
include_non_physical.question: Are objects with a non-physical material (origin and georeference markers, zone volumes) counted?
include_non_physical.help: No: they are left out and listed as excluded. Authoring tools add them for placement and display only.

optionLabels.all: Everything in the model, whatever its status
optionLabels.new_work: New work only: existing and demolished elements are left out

renovation_scope.label: Renovation scope
renovation_scope.question: Does this BoQ cover everything in the model, or only new work (renovation)?
renovation_scope.help: Uses each element's status in the model (the IFC Status property, or Revit phases). Elements left out are not measured and not asked about; the log counts them.

measure_demolition.label: Measure demolition
measure_demolition.question: Are elements marked for demolition measured as demolition items?
measure_demolition.help: One line per element type: m3 where the element has a volume, otherwise a count.

room_finishes.label: Finishes room by room
room_finishes.question: Do you measure floor, ceiling and wall finishes and skirting room by room, from the rooms (IFC spaces)?
room_finishes.help: Floor and ceiling area, wall area less the doors and windows in its walls, perimeter less door widths. Uses the IFC space quantities if the file has them, else the room solid. Usually instead of finishes from modelled coverings, not as well.

optionLabels.over_threshold: Columns larger than a size limit deducted

room_column_mode.label: Columns in rooms
room_column_mode.question: When finishes are measured room by room, is the plan area of columns standing in a room deducted from its floor and ceiling?

room_column_threshold.label: Column size limit
room_column_threshold.question: Above which plan area are columns deducted?

items.label: Plates, panels and building element parts
Roofs
items.description: Roof, {type_name}{expr: IF(p.roof_breakdown = "layer", ", layer " + material, "")}{expr: IF(p.lines_by_storey, ", " + storey, "")}

items.label: Floor finishes by room
items.description: Floor finish, {expr: COALESCE(space_type, type_name, name)}{expr: IF(p.lines_by_storey, ", " + storey, "")}

items.label: Ceiling finishes by room

quantity.expr: ceiling_area - COALESCE(SUM(embedded.area WHERE p.room_column_mode = "all" OR (p.room_column_mode = "over_threshold" AND area > p.room_column_threshold)), 0)

items.description: Ceiling finish, {expr: COALESCE(space_type, type_name, name)}{expr: IF(p.lines_by_storey, ", " + storey, "")}

items.label: Wall finishes by room
items.description: Wall finish, {expr: COALESCE(space_type, type_name, name)}, less openings{expr: IF(p.lines_by_storey, ", " + storey, "")}

items.label: Skirting by room
items.description: Skirting, {expr: COALESCE(space_type, type_name, name)}{expr: IF(p.lines_by_storey, ", " + storey, "")}

derived.label: Hardcore under ground slabs
derived.description: Hardcore bed under ground slabs, {p.hardcore_thickness*1000} mm
